text: What is code quality, really? Elegant? Clever? Short? None of those.
It’s how cheaply and safely you can make the next change: find the place, change it once, and know nothing else broke.
You can measure it: duplication, complexity smells, test coverage and churn.
And read the trend. Eight percent and falling beats four percent and climbing.
Sensei measures these at sampled commits across your real git history.
